name: Lag Reducer
description: Particle budget optimization with live settings in the level pause menu.

enabled.name: Enable particle optimization
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn off to restore normal particle budgets and emission rates.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle optimization strength
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = normal. 1-10 progressively reduce particle emission and max capacity; 10 keeps about 20% of each emitter's original particle budget. High values may remove visual effects.
